# UK to lead G7 in AI adoption with £2.5 Billion growth package

- [Open Access News](https://www.openaccessgovernment.org/category/open-access-news/)
- [Finance](https://www.openaccessgovernment.org/category/open-access-news/finance-news/)

## The UK government has pledged £2.5 billion to secure leadership in AI and Quantum technology. Chancellor Rachel Reeves aims for the fastest AI adoption in the G7 and a “Quantum leap” that could add over £200 billion to the economy, emphasising a strategic state role in the industries of the future

Centred on the “three big choices” for national growth—innovation, closer ties with Europe, and regional development—the strategy seeks to anchor the world’s most promising technology firms in Britain.

The plan includes a world-first commitment to rolling out quantum computers at scale, a move projected to create 100,000 jobs and [generate £212 billion over the next two decades.](https://www.gov.uk/government/news/uk-will-win-ai-race-as-chancellor-sets-out-economic-big-choices)

### The “Sovereign AI” strategy: AI adoption

The government is moving away from a “market-only” approach to prevent AI benefits from being concentrated among a few global entities. A new £500 million Sovereign AI Fund will launch in April to provide British firms with the funding and “compute” power necessary to compete internationally.

#### Key AI adoption objectives

- Fastest G7 Adoption:
[Implementing AI](https://www.openaccessgovernment.org/how-ai-is-transforming-accounts-payable-and-compliance-auditing/205960/) across the public and private sectors is quicker than in any other major economy.
- Sovereign Capability:
Ensuring the UK shapes and owns the technology rather than relying on foreign models.
- Startup Ecosystem:
Building on the fact that since 2020, more AI companies have been founded in Britain per capita than anywhere else in Europe.

### The quantum leap

While[AI is the technology](https://www.openaccessgovernment.org/smarter-safer-public-sector-payments/197255/) of the current era, the Chancellor identified Quantum as the next generational leap. Unlike traditional computers, quantum systems can explore multiple solutions simultaneously, drastically reducing the time needed to solve complex problems in healthcare and energy.

#### The £2 billion quantum package includes

- Scalable Procurement:
A £1 billion program to purchase commercial-scale quantum computers, making the UK the first to prove large-scale market demand.
- Research Hubs:
£13.8 million for five National Quantum Research Hubs focusing on clean energy and national security.
- Commercialisation Skills:
£12 million for a specialised centre to help scientists translate laboratory breakthroughs into real-world business products.

### Real-world impact and industry support

The investment is designed to deliver “cutting-edge public services” and high-paid jobs. Industry leaders, including CEOs from Riverlane and Oxford Quantum Circuits, have praised the move as a vital signal to private investors that the UK is committed to scaled technology rather than just theoretical research.

#### Anticipated Benefits

- Healthcare:
Using quantum sensors to improve diagnostics for conditions like childhood epilepsy and Alzheimer’s.
- Infrastructure:
Monitoring gas leaks across energy networks and removing reliance on satellite technology for transport navigation.
- Economic renewal:
Strengthening ties with Europe while backing homegrown innovation to ensure the UK remains a global tech “magnet.”

# 英國推出 25 億英鎊成長方案，力拚成為七大工業國組織 AI 應用領導者

- [開放近用新聞](https://www.openaccessgovernment.org/category/open-access-news/)
- [財經](https://www.openaccessgovernment.org/category/open-access-news/finance-news/)

## 英國政府承諾投入 25 億英鎊，以確立其在人工智慧（AI）與量子科技領域的領導地位。財政大臣瑞秋・里夫斯（Rachel Reeves）希望英國成為七大工業國組織（G7）中應用 AI 速度最快的國家，並推動一場可望為經濟挹注超過 2,000 億英鎊的「量子躍進」，同時強調政府應在未來產業中扮演策略性角色

這項策略以促進國家成長的「三大抉擇」為核心——創新、深化與歐洲的關係，以及區域發展——旨在吸引全球最具潛力的科技企業扎根英國。

該計畫包括一項全球首創的承諾，將大規模部署量子電腦，預計可創造 10 萬個工作機會，並在[未來 20 年創造 2,120 億英鎊的經濟效益。](https://www.gov.uk/government/news/uk-will-win-ai-race-as-chancellor-sets-out-economic-big-choices)

### 「主權 AI」策略：推動 AI 應用

英國政府正揚棄「唯市場」的做法，以避免 AI 帶來的利益集中在少數全球企業手中。規模達 5 億英鎊的新「主權 AI 基金」將於 4 月啟動，為英國企業提供在國際市場競爭所需的資金與「運算資源」。

#### AI 應用的主要目標

- G7 最快應用：
在公私部門[導入 AI](https://www.openaccessgovernment.org/how-ai-is-transforming-accounts-payable-and-compliance-auditing/205960/)的速度超越其他主要經濟體。
- 自主技術能力：
確保英國能主導並擁有相關技術，而非依賴外國模型。
- 新創生態系：
延續英國自 2020 年以來的優勢——按人均計算，英國成立的 AI 公司數量比歐洲其他國家都多。

### 量子躍進

儘管 [AI 是當前時代的科技](https://www.openaccessgovernment.org/smarter-safer-public-sector-payments/197255/)，財政大臣仍將量子科技定位為下一個世代的重大躍進。與傳統電腦不同，量子系統能同時探索多種解決方案，大幅縮短處理醫療與能源領域複雜問題所需的時間。

#### 20 億英鎊的量子科技方案包括

- 規模化採購：
投入 10 億英鎊採購商用規模的量子電腦，讓英國成為第一個證明市場存在大規模需求的國家。
- 研究中心：
投入 1,380 萬英鎊設立五座國家量子研究中心，聚焦於潔淨能源與國家安全。
- 商業化技能：
投入 1,200 萬英鎊成立專責中心，協助科學家將實驗室的突破轉化為實際的商業產品。

### 實際影響與產業支持

這項投資旨在提供「尖端公共服務」並創造高薪工作機會。Riverlane 與 Oxford Quantum Circuits 執行長等產業領袖皆對此舉表示肯定，認為這向民間投資者釋出重要訊號：英國致力於推動技術規模化，而不只停留在理論研究。

#### 預期效益

- 醫療保健：
運用量子感測器改善兒童癲癇、阿茲海默症等疾病的診斷。
- 基礎建設：
監測能源網路中的氣體洩漏，並降低交通導航對衛星技術的依賴。
- 經濟振興：
在支持本土創新的同時，強化與歐洲的關係，確保英國持續成為吸引全球科技產業的「磁石」。
